verdict.rationale: Penpot ships an official MCP server built on its open plugin API, which it describes as enabling multi-directional AI workflows. Its marketing pages say agents can interact with design files to create artifacts, generate editable design structures, and migrate designs into Penpot, so write access is claimed and not just read access. Missing for 10: detailed first-party reference docs for the write operations (create/modify shapes, components, tokens) via MCP or the plugin API, any published API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can write designs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create or modify designs programmatically — through a write-capable API, plugin surface, or MCP tools — not just read them

citations.quote: Penpot MCP server is agnostic and enables high-quality multi-directional AI workflows through our world-class open plugin API.
AI agents can easily read and interact with your design files creating high-fidelity artifacts.
Penpot enables plenty of AI workflows, from generating editable design structures to connecting product logic, tokens, and implementation.
Migrate your designs into Penpot by connecting Figma’s and Penpot’s MCPs.
Our plugin system brings the flexibility that devs need to create and publish their own custom extensions.
